**Finding submitted — T4C: deviation (preferred-level cure proposed).**

- **What the document does:** Base Agreement § 4.0 (p0104) commits a three-year term, terminable only "as provided in Section 5.0", and § 5.1 (p0107) allows termination by either Party only "for cause". SOW Attachment 1 § 2.0 (p0658) mirrors the three-year commitment. IBM has no convenience exit from the Agreement in a multi-year term — walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Not double-flagged:** the six-month / twelve-month notices in §§ 4.0 and 2.0 operate only against automatic renewal (RENEWAL, not T4C), and § 6.1 (p0722) PO cancellation is order-level and carries cost reimbursements, so it is not an Agreement-level convenience right.
- **Vendor side already acceptable:** MSL may exit only for cause during the committed term, so the fourth preferred element is already met and was left untouched (the CDA § 8 mutual notice right terminates only that confidentiality exchange agreement).
- **Cure:** one insert after p0143 adding § 5.4 — IBM convenience termination on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. No partial-termination language, penalties, or other boilerplate added.
